title: Your retro games. Your next move.
lead: Take your RetroHub library with you. Play offline on your phone, then pick up where you left off on the web.
screens_note: App screenshots with a demo library. The app interface is in French.
app_body: A home screen that feels like a console. Your library, recent games and settings are always close at hand.
home_title: Pick up where you left off.
home_body: Choose a game from the row of covers. Your latest save, play time and sync status stay in view.
library_body: Browse your covers, filter by console and keep your favourites close. Download the games you want to take with you.
settings_body: Image rendering, resolution, buttons and fast-forward speed: adjust each console to the way you play.
alt_home: RetroHub home with a row of game covers, the selected game and cards for resuming, play time and sync status
alt_library: RetroHub library showing several game covers and a console filter
alt_conflict: Two saves of the same game, on the phone and server, each with a button to choose it
cap_home: The home screen and recent games
cap_conflict: Both saves have changed? You choose which one to keep.
offline_body: Download your games before heading out. They stay playable offline; your saves sync when you reconnect.
controls_body: Touch controls match each console. Connect a controller and they step aside. You can navigate the whole app with its buttons, too.
saves_body: Start on your phone, continue in your browser. Your saves and play time follow your RetroHub account.
saves_detail: If you have played on both devices, the app lets you choose the save to keep before replacing anything.
consoles_body: Emulators are built into the app. Choose a game and start playing.
compatibility_note: Performance depends on your phone, especially for Nintendo 64 and GameCube. Some systems require a BIOS.
install_body: A free app that connects to your own RetroHub server.
install_1_body: Download the APK from GitHub. Open it on your phone and allow installation if Android asks.
install_2_body: Enter its address, then the pairing code shown in RetroHub on the web, or sign in with your password.
install_3_body: Your library appears in the app. Download a game to play it, even offline.
server_body: RetroHub hosts your library and saves on your own hardware. The app connects to it to access your games; no games are included.
